subject: Request: Trial runway extension and bootstrap credits — QuantForge POC
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan@quantforge.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@quantforge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline slipping — request for short trial/top-up

Hi Rohan,

Hope you had a good long weekend. Quick update from our side: the engineering team hit a blocker with our SSO integration (third-party library incompatibility) and our devs are focused on that fix for the next 2–3 weeks. That means our POC with Redwood will not reach the demo milestone we planned for mid-June.

Given the delay, could Redwood consider extending our trial by 30 days and topping up the sandbox with an extra $3k of credits so we can continue smoke testing once the SSO fix lands? We really like the runtime performance in the early tests and want to keep momentum, but we need a little runway.

I attached the integration logs that show the issue (integration_logs_20270601.zip) and an updated POC plan (poc-plan-v2.pdf). Happy to jump on a short call.

Thanks,
Megan Liu
Director of Platform — QuantForge
megan@quantforge.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Liu <megan@quantforge.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@quantforge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline slipping — request for short trial/top-up

Megan —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the SSO snag — that’s annoying. Appreciate the transparency.

We can absolutely try to keep the POC momentum. Tentatively I can offer: a 30-day trial extension and a $2,500 sandbox credit top-up today, plus a contingency of an additional $1,000 credit if you confirm the SSO fix and we see the demo within the revised window.

Before I lock that in I need a short thumbsup from biz ops / sales leadership. I’ll loop in Monica and Aditya for approval and copy Stephanie from finance for billing alignment. If approved, I’ll send an official amendment and extend the sandbox.

Would you be available for a quick 20-min sync tomorrow to align expectations and share a checklist of what we’ll validate during the extra window?

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request — QuantForge POC: 30d extension + up to $3.5k credits

Team —

QuantForge (QF-2027-342) ran into an SSO integration issue that pushes their demo ~2–3 weeks. They’re asking for a 30-day trial extension and an initial $3k sandbox top-up. I proposed $2.5k now + contingent $1k after they validate the fix and hit the demo milestone.

Why I recommend approval:
- Deal health: strong engagement from platform and infra; demo scheduled previously showed clear product/ROI alignment.
- Likely conversion timeline: if they can demo within the new window we keep momentum for a late Q3 commit.
- Low cost relative to expected ARR for a mid-market account.

Requesting:
- Approve 30-day trial extension
- Approve immediate $2,500 sandbox credit top-up, with an additional $1,000 contingent upon demo completion within the revised timeline

Notes: Megan attached logs and an updated POC plan (see attachments). If approved I’ll send an amendment + update HubSpot deal stage.

Thanks,
Rohan
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request — QuantForge POC: 30d extension + up to $3.5k credits

Rohan —

I’m good to approve this with the contingency language you proposed. Approve the 30-day extension and the immediate $2,500 sandbox credit. Hold the additional $1,000 until we get confirmation of the demo (screenshot/scheduled recording or equivalent).

Stephanie — please note for billing and promo tracking; map credits to deal QF-2027-342 and set a reminder for 35 days out to check status.

Also please attach a short success checklist for the POC (3 validation points) to the amendment so QuantForge knows the acceptance criteria. Rohan, add that and send it out.

-Monica
VP, Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Liu <megan@quantforge.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@quantforge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC timeline slipping — request for short trial/top-up

Megan —

Thanks for your patience. Quick summary and next steps: 

1) Approved: 30-day trial extension effective today (ends 2027-07-03).
2) Approved: $2,500 sandbox credit top-up applied to your sandbox (account will show promo "QF_POC_TOPUP_2500").
3) Contingent: Additional $1,000 promo credit available upon confirmation of demo completion within the revised window. Please share a recording or scheduled demo invite + brief checklist evidence (see attached amendment draft).

Action items:
- Megan/Sanjay: confirm a 20-min sync tomorrow 10–10:30 PT to align on the checklist and timeline.
- Rohan: I will upload the amendment to HubSpot, attach the 3-point acceptance criteria, and route to Megan for e-signature.
- Stephanie: please map promo to QF-2027-342 and set a 35-day reminder.

Attachments: amendment_draft_for_qf_v1.pdf (contains the 3-point POC success checklist and promo terms).

Looking forward — we want to make this run smoothly and keep you on track to evaluate the platform fully.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
